description: Frames of the JSON-line protocol, as a guest sees and sends them. 'frame' is the JSON text of one line; 'valid' is whether the Go contract accepts it as the section's frame type (strict decoding, then the frame's own rules). A reverse response is judged against the id of the call that waits for it ('id'). A binding passes when it reproduces every outcome. Regenerate with EXT_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 go test -run TestSDKFixtures ./pkg/plugin-go/contract.

reverseRequest.name: session-scoped reverse request: the base frame

reverseResponse.name: payload with deep nesting within the bound
